text:
Introduction
This document lists the equipment Inspection checklist I2, which
must be performed for Becker compressor type SV 250 max pressure150 discharge
every four months as indicated by M4 in the title block.
Safety Precautions
A work permit 
must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable 
safety category.
Safety fence 
with caution marks surrounding the work area.
Wear standard personal safety and healthy equipment as helmet, safety shoes, 
rubber gloves, ... etc.
Tools and Equipment
Personal safety equipment, helmet, and safety glasses
Work to be Carried Out
Clean compressor room floor.
